en: **Content scope:** Coins in whole shekels. Total amount — addition or equal groups (multiplication). One step. Up to ~100. No agorot, no multi-step buying.
de: **Inhaltsumfang:** Coins in whole Euro. Total amount — addition oder gleich groups (multiplication). One step. Up ~100. No agorot, no multi-step buying.

de: - `wp_coins`: ₪ whole Euro only; single-step totals; gleich groups / multiplication OK (e.g. 4 × 5); up ~100; no agorot, no multi-step money

en: **Content scope:** Multiplication in word problems — equal groups. One step. Grade 2 factor range. No division, no multi-step questions.
de: **Inhaltsumfang:** Multiplication in Textaufgaben — gleich groups. One step. 2. Klasse Teiler range. No division, no multi-step questions.

en: **Content scope:** Difference between two amounts — **"how many more"**. One step. Numbers up to **1,000**. No multi-step subtraction.
de: **Inhaltsumfang:** Difference between two amounts — **"Wie viele mehr"**. One step. Numbers up **1,000**. No multi-step subtraction.

en: **Content scope:** Vertical multiplication — two-digit number × one digit. Regrouping (carrying). No two two-digit numbers.
de: **Inhaltsumfang:** Vertical multiplication — two-digit number × one digit. Regrouping (carrying). No two two-digit numbers.

en: We will learn what a quarter turn is — a rotation of 90° — like when you turn an arrow a quarter of the way around.

en: **Content scope:** Division in word problems — fair sharing. One step. No remainder, no long division. Story only.
de: **Inhaltsumfang:** Division in Textaufgaben — fair sharing. One step. No Rest, no long division. Story only.
